evaluation_metric: Agreement, Effective Date & Contract Reference Clarity
evaluation_pointer: Verify whether effective date, governing agreement, contract references, amendment clauses, and legal applicability are clearly defined
Verify whether project objectives, operational expectations, services to be provided, and business scope are clearly documented

evaluation_metric: Services to be Provided by Service Provider
evaluation_pointer: Verify whether all operational, reporting, support, enhancement, refresh, QC, validation, and stakeholder support activities are clearly listed
Verify whether supported activities, exclusions, enhancement limitations, and operational boundaries are clearly separated
Verify whether deliverables such as refreshed reports, extracts, QC checklists, validations, insights, and operational outputs are clearly defined
Verify whether project duration, completion dates, milestone expectations, refresh schedules, and operational timelines are documented
Verify whether project leaders, delivery managers, escalation contacts, invoicing contacts, and governance ownership are documented
Verify whether delivery hierarchy, team structure, operational ownership, and resource responsibilities are clearly defined
Verify whether client/vendor responsibilities, operational ownership, dependency handling, and support responsibilities are clearly assigned

evaluation_metric: Compensation, Cost, Pricing & Billing Rate Structure
evaluation_pointer: Verify whether pricing structure, blended billing rates, enhancement rates, compensation limits, pass-through costs, and commercial expectations are clearly documented
Verify whether invoicing frequency, payment milestones, invoice conditions, billing cycles, and milestone-based payment schedules are documented
Verify whether travel clauses, reimbursement handling, pass-through approval conditions, and additional cost governance are documented
Verify whether change requests, enhancement limits, additional billing conditions, and scope revision handling are documented
Verify whether milestone completion criteria, acceptance expectations, approval workflows, and sign-off conditions are documented
Verify whether dashboard refresh support, discrepancy handling, stakeholder query support, QC expectations, and operational SLAs are clearly defined
Verify whether assumptions, operational constraints, dependency handling, and risk conditions are documented
Verify whether strategic objectives, business alignment, and transformation goals are documented
Verify whether revision logs, version tracking, documentation governance, and audit traceability are maintained
Verify whether workflow diagrams, operational flows, and scope representations are visually documented
Verify whether future enhancements, scalability expectations, and operational growth planning are documented
Verify whether confidentiality clauses, compliance obligations, IP ownership, and legal governance expectations are documented
